ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure compares China's cotton purchase guide price, sown area, and yield per unit area in 1998 and 2000. The cotton purchase guide price fell from 617.5 yuan/dan in 1998 to 390.0 yuan/dan in 2000, a decrease of 37%; the sown area fell from 4.459 million hectares to 4.041 million hectares, a decrease of 9%; but the yield per unit area rose from 1009 kg/hectare to 1093 kg/hectare, an increase of 8%. Reasoning: After the purchase guide price dropped sharply, the income attractiveness of planting cotton weakened, and some farmers or regions would reduce cotton planting. Regions with relatively low yield per unit area had lower returns from planting cotton and were more likely to switch to other crops; those left continuing to plant cotton were mostly regions with relatively high yields. Therefore, the statistically calculated cotton yield per unit area in 2000 was relatively large.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the "relationship graph between Chinese policy and cotton production."

<image1>

According to the figure, what is the main reason that China's cotton yield per unit area was relatively large in 2000?
raw_record.standard_answer: Regions with small yield per unit area switched to planting other crops

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify that from 1998 to 2000 the cotton purchase guide price dropped sharply, cotton sown area also decreased, but unit-area yield increased. Then connect these: the lower purchase price made cotton less attractive, so some farmers stopped planting cotton. Since low-yield areas would be least profitable, they were the most likely to switch to other crops. Therefore the remaining cotton area was relatively higher-yield, causing the 2000 unit-area yield to appear larger. Answer: low unit-area-yield regions switched to other crops.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中比较了1998年和2000年我国棉花收购指导价、播种面积和单位面积产量。棉花收购指导价由1998年的617.5元/担降到2000年的390.0元/担，下降37%；播种面积由445.9万公顷降到404.1万公顷，下降9%；但单位面积产量由1009千克/公顷升到1093千克/公顷，上升8%。推理：收购指导价大幅下降后，种植棉花的收益吸引力减弱，部分农民或地区会减少棉花种植。单位面积产量较低的地区种棉收益更低，更可能改种其他农作物；留下继续种棉的多为产量较高的地区。因此2000年统计出的棉花单位面积产量较大。
method.model_answer: 单位面积产量小的地区转种其他农作物。

method.method_draft: First describe the image: note that the cotton area shrank by 9% from 1998 to 2000, yet average yield per unit area rose by 8%. Treat the national unit-area yield as an average over all cotton-growing regions.
